notes.title: Taco Amigos is Now Available!
notes.content:
Good day, chefs! It's finally time: today we open our very own Mexican restaurant! [b]Taco Amigos[/b], the new campaign (single and coop) for [b]Diner Bros[/b], is now available!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32619230/386deb26ba8cf0a6cf34f58715b9e1b3ea730f8c.png[/img]

Here's what awaits you in [b]Taco Amigos[/b]:
[list][*][b]Cook brand new Mexican recipes[/b]: burritos, beans, rice, salsa… and of course, tacos!
[*][b]Serve new drinks[/b]: soda and tequila
[*][b]Attend to 5 new special customers[/b], including Muertos, Luchador, and Mariachi
[*][b]Expand your restaurant[/b] with new kitchen equipment and items
[*][b]Hire helpers[/b]: [i]SOFÍA [/i]can chop and [i]LUCÍA [/i]will help too![/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1252980/Diner_Bros__Taco_Amigos_Campaign/
Are you a little rusty and haven't cooked with us in a while? Don't miss out on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/846800/announcements/detail/1706233347160767430]little buddies[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/846800/announcements/detail/1664569976918357218]masked amigos[/url].  And if you want to be a super star, leave a review for Diner Bros and Taco Amigos -- let others know how much you love cooking!

[url=https://discord.gg/Rqtwnjc]Discord[/url] | [url=https://twitter.com/dinerbros]Twitter[/url]

notes.title: Sushi Bros is available!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32619230/4467c2bc0699262d18a5901da80426d239186b78.jpg[/img]

Good day, chefs! The day has come: today you can open your very own Japanese restaurant! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1095500/Diner_Bros__Sushi_Bros/]Sushi Bros, the new campaign (single and coop) for Diner Bros, is now available![/url] 

Here's what you will find in Sushi Bros: 

[list]
[*] [b]Cook brand new Japanese recipes: [/b]rice, edamame, maki, sashimi, nigiri, grilled fish, yakitori, soy sauce… and of course, sushi!
[*] [b]Serve new drinks: [/b]tea and sake
[*] Expand your restaurant with a [b]fishing pier…[/b]
[*] …and [b]catch your own fish![/b]
[*] Attend to [b]4 new special customers, [/b]including Mr. Kabuki and Princess Hime
[*] [b]New equipment[/b] and items for your kitchen
[/list]

But that's not all! We are also happy to announce that we have also added a new split-screen Versus mode for you to [*]play against your friends[*] to find out who's the fastest and most efficient chef. This new Versus mode is [b]included in the base game for free[/b]! Enjoy your cooking duels!

If you want to help us, leave us your review of Diner Bros and Sushi Bros -- let others know how much you love cooking!

notes.title: Pizza Bros is here!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32619230/ac85888a1200a01fddf84ed11b9b76e06706a1a8.jpg[/img]

Welcome, chefs! During these past months we've paid a lot of attention to your feedback (thanks a lot!), and one thing was very clear: you wanted more -- of everything! More recipes to cook, more ingredients to chop and mix, more drinks to pour, more clients to serve... As our [url=https://discord.gg/phDCag]Discord subscribers[/url] know, we've been in the kitchen for some time now, working in some [b]tasty new content for Diner Bros,[/b] and today we are happy to announce today the release of [b]Pizza Bros,[/b] our first major update! 

[b]Pizza Bros is a brand new campaign for Diner Bros where you manage a pizza joint.[/b] There are new dishes for you to cook, new special customers, new items and food processors... and on top of that, new challenge levels for you to test your skills and reflexes! Oh, and something very important:[b] Pizza Bros is totally free! [/b]Enjoy your pizzas! 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HlLCZQryX-w
[h1][b]NEW FEATURES [/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] New pizza restaurant
[*] New bro: the Italian chef
[*] New customers: The lumberjack who eats a lot, the diva, the thief... and more surprises!
[*] New recipes: pizza, bread, roasted potatoes
[*] New ingredients: pepperoni, mushrooms, white wine, coffee
[*] New kitchen items
[/list]

notes.title: Halloween Update: Zombie Bros!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32619230/a069fb078edb4225bb7a2970021f321869b810a6.jpg[/img]

Good day, chefs! [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/846800/announcements/detail/1703943496324539497]Remember the weird guy that had us cowering for days?[/url] Turns out he was[b] a zombie -- and there are hundreds and hundreds like him coming to Diner Bros![/b] As long as we keep them fed it should be fine... 

We're spooked to announce our Halloween Update featuring[b] Zombie Bros, a new endless level[/b] where hordes of zombies will keep coming to your restaurant -- keep them fed and happy to survive as long as you can. And to celebrate this update, Diner Bros will have a tasty [b] -15% discount [/b]for a few days!

There are some more quality of life changes included in this update, make sure to check the patch notes below. [b]Happy Halloween to you all! [/b]

[h1][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]New Endless Level:[/b] Zombie Bros!
[*][b]New Achievements:[/b] Zombie Bros I, II & III
[/list]
[h1][b]CHANGES[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Added rolling pin to smack dine and dashers!
[*]Punks can only be caught when they are sneaking away
[*]Modified hit boxes on Punks
[*]Beer icon is now darker to differentiate it from Yellow Drink icon
[*]Reduced Quest requirements
[list]
[*]Baked potatoes: 20 --> 15
[*]Beer: 25 --> 15
[*]Burgers: 100 --> 90
[*]Dessert: 35 --> 25
[/list]
[*]Reduced Achievement requirements
[list]
[*]Hard Worker: 50 --> 40
[*]Artsy Fartsy: 20--> 15
[*]Dine and Dash: 25--> 20
[/list]
[*]Added Endless select screen
[*]Added Divas & Artists to Stats screen
[/list]

notes.title: Korean Localization and Hardcore Levels
notes.content:
Good day chefs! We've been busy in the kitchen for a few weeks, and we're happy to bring some new and tasty content to your tables: today Diner Bros receives a new update! The first thing we want to announce is that now Diner Bros is fully localized to Korean! Korean gamers have supported us since its release, and we wanted to give back some of that love. To all our players from there: 고맙습니다! We're also adding a fan-made Czech translation; huge kudos and thanks to its author, David Koncivny!

But that's not all, folks! For those of you who have tested your skills with the knife and pan by impressing all the critics and beating both the campaign and the Challenge Level, here you have 2 new hardcore levels that will put your cool, skill, and reflexes to a test. Good luck with them -- you're going to need it... but as they say, if you can't stand the heat, get out of the kitchen! 

There are some other changes in this update, such as a new secret achievement and some quality-of-life fixes. You will find a comprehensive list below. Enjoy the update, and bon appétit!

[h1][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]5 New Challenge Levels![/b] Including 2 hardcore levels
[*][b]New Achievement:[/b] Triple Chop [Secret]
[*][b]New Languages:[/b] Korean, Czech (Fan Translation)
[/list]
[h1][b]CHANGES[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Increased difficulty of "Quadathlon" and "King of Punks"
[*]Reduced frequency of Divas in campaign and endless mode
[*]Larger hitbox on Punks (Should make it easier to catch them!)
[/list]
[h1][b]FIXES[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]The endless mode achievements will now correctly unlock ("Is that all?" and "I ain't even tired").  If you have already met the requirements, start and finish an endless game with any score to unlock them.
[*]Fixed character select screen freeze that would occur with multiple controllers
[*]The message "The Critic was not Impressed" will now correctly show up
[*]Fixed inverted DPad for multiple controllers
[*]Starting a new game in easy mode will now correctly set the game's difficulty
[/list]

notes.title: Monthversary Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32619230/ef3dd9cb6e8d0e5f07bf37c9d59ff5d9d253fe19.jpg[/img]

Good day chefs! It's been one month since we released Diner Bros, and we want to thank you all for your support. But as we told you when we opened the doors of this restaurant, opening day was but the first step on a long journey for a game that will keep growing and receiving new content over the next months. To celebrate the first month on Steam, we're releasing today our [b]Monthversary Update[/b] with new features, such as 11 new challenge levels, a new Special Costumer, a new Endless Mode, and many new achievements -- along with some quality of life fixes and changes. Check out the full patch notes below. And to mark this occasion, we're happy to announce that [b]Diner Bros will be -10% off[/b] for a few days. Bon appétit!

[h1][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*][b]11 New Challenge Levels![/b] Now including HARDCORE levels
[*][b]New Special Customer![/b] The Diva will begin visiting after obtaining 2 stars
[*][b]Endless Mode![/b] How long can you last? Unlocked after obtaining 3 stars
[*][b]The Burger Trophy![/b] Can be purchased after obtaining 3 stars
[*][b]Auto-run![/b] Activate this feature in the Options Menu
[*][b]New Achievements:[/b]
[list]
     [*]Diva Tantrum
     [*]Keep 'em coming!
     [*]Is that all?
     [*]I ain't even tired!
     [*]Challenge III
     [*]The Golden Burger (Secret!)
[/list]
[/list]
[h1][b]CHANGES[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]The Artist:[/b]
[list]
     [*]The Old Artist behavior has been assigned to the Diva.  The New Artist will now arrive part way through the 2 star restaurant with a new behavior.
     [*]The Diva/Old Artist patience has been increased
     [*]The Diva/Old Artist will no longer order "Chicken and Fries"
[/list]
[*][b]Challenge Mode:[/b]
[list]
     [*]Now playable solo.  Solo players have a faster sprint and can hold multiple items.  Levels marked as "2+" are still co-op only.
     [*]Increased difficulty (Challenge mode should be challenging!)
[/list]
[*][b]Food Critic:[/b]
[list]
     [*]Will now be satisfied if his order is completed (Previously, he had to be served quickly leading to difficulty in the final stages)
     [*]Arrives slightly earlier
[/list]
[*]Updated achievement icons
[/list]
[h1][b]FIXES[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Character Select now remembers the last character each player picked
[*]Improved aiming/movement (Feedback appreciated!)
[*]Improved balancing (1-2 players slightly easier, 3-4 players slightly harder)
[*]Changed location of star counter in challenge mode
[*]Customers won't emote "no" when player serves a drink while multi-holding 2 drink types
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.16: Mouse Support and Easy Mode
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32619230/b256ba29ff1242673ae98a915fcbdec22efa8ec9.jpg[/img]

Thank you for all your support this past weekend.  Based on your feedback we have implemented alternative controls for keyboard users and an optional easy mode.  With these changes, we hope that players of all skill levels can enjoy the game from start to finish.  As always, both modes may need to be adjusted in the future.  Your comments are very much appreciated.  Remember that you can send us your feedback via our official [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/846800/discussions/]Steam forums[/url] and our social media channels ([url=https://twitter.com/dinerbros]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/dinerbrosgame/]Facebook[/url]). Bon appétit!

[h1]Update 1.16 Change Log[/h1]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Easy Mode: Removed 4 & 5 star quest requirements, added simple quests, increased customer wait times, reduced customer frequency.
[*]Mouse Control: Keyboard players can use the mouse to interact.  Use the arrow keys to get close and then LCLICK to pick up/drop and RCLICK to interact.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug where player could not advance in the tutorial.
[*]Fixed bug where character could face a different direction than player input.
[/list]
